expectedItems.name: Paracetamol
expectedItems.sourceSentence: Take Paracetamol 500 mg twice daily after food for 3 days.

expectedItems.name: Incision care
expectedItems.sourceSentence: Keep the incision clean and dry. Do not soak the wound.

expectedItems.name: Fever
expectedItems.sourceSentence: Contact the hospital for fever, increasing abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, or wound discharge.
